title: When the Atlas Burns
author: Bram Brightwater
blurb: Coral Halloran, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
